serviceDescription: Workstreet is a public sector compliance advisory that guides technology companies through CMMC, FedRAMP 20x, GovRAMP, CJIS, and NIST 800-171/800-53 authorization, using a five-step automation-first methodology covering scoping, policy foundation, gap remediation, documentation (SSPs, POA&Ms), and coordination with C3PAOs/3PAOs through final certification.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Scoping, gap assessment, and implementation support for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2, including preparation for C3PAO assessment.
Guidance through FedRAMP 20x and GovRAMP authorization at Low, Moderate, and High impact levels, including 3PAO coordination and readiness preparation.
Control implementation, gap remediation, and documentation support mapped to NIST 800-171 and NIST 800-53 requirements.
Development of System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), risk assessment reports, and continuous monitoring procedures.
End-to-end management of the authorization process, including assessor coordination, finding remediation, and evidence supplementation.
